title: Start-stop operation and disable controls
summary: Reviews about the start-stop feature focus on how smoothly it operates and how easy or awkward it is to disable or override.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise smooth and effective start-stop behavior and say it makes traffic driving less stressful.

negative.summary: Negative reviews complain that disabling or overriding start-stop is awkward, buried in infotainment, or lacks a simple permanent off control.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments often mention improved or sensitive start-stop behavior or app-based deactivation, but the sample does not provide enough context to assign clear sentiment consistently.

limitations: Many fragments are too short or context-poor to determine clear sentiment.
Some examples appear misaligned with the assigned sentiment, so the topic should be read as a cluster about start-stop mentions rather than a fully consistent opinion set.
The cluster includes both feature performance and control-interface comments, which are related but distinct aspects.
